_about: Subdivision merges judged by AP and applied by Claude from chat rulings. Hand judgement, not regenerable. No pipeline stage writes this file.
_rule: Bases listed together are one naming act. The family distance split still applies afterwards, so a listed base sitting far from the rest stays separate on its own -- that is deliberate, and is how Seamans 02nd stays out of Seaman's.

directional._rule: A base that is another base plus a trailing NORTH/SOUTH/EAST/WEST is the same naming act, when the two are within the family distance.
directional._skip_why: Both were judged apart on theme in phase_merges.json: Harris Ranch has 26 sawmill names against 6 birds, and merging through the Shelburne parent would make two unrelated developments peers. Pending AP's ruling on whether distance now overrides that.
